directAnswer.en: Compressor is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump swing cylinder seal φ70 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. The φ70 swing-cylinder seal is a set for the swing or pendulum cylinder on an S-valve concrete pump, supplied from Xingtai. The catalogue does not name which published pump uses φ70.
directAnswer.zh: 《压缩机》是百科页。concrete pump swing cylinder seal φ70仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 φ70 摆缸密封是邢台供应的一套，用于 S 阀混凝土泵的摆缸。目录没有写哪一台已公布泵使用 φ70。

body.en: The heading “Types” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. Part type: swing / pendulum cylinder seal kit. Sizes: φ60 / φ70 / φ80 / φ90. This row is φ70. Unit: set. Material and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. φ70 is also a swing-arm ball diameter. The ball page adds white or black and upper or lower. This seal row does not. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 标题“类型”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 配件类型：摆缸密封套件。尺寸：φ60 / φ70 / φ80 / φ90。这一行是 φ70。单位：套。材料和寿命缺失。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 φ70 也是摆臂球头直径。球头页还有白或黑、上或下。这一密封行没有这些字。 标题到此为止。

heading.zh: 热力学的 gas 压缩

body.en: Where the source outline says “Thermodynamics of gas compression”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write swing-cylinder seal φ70 and the quantity in sets. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“热力学的 gas 压缩”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明摆缸密封 φ70 和套数。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Temperature” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. The φ70 swing-cylinder seal is a set for the swing or pendulum cylinder on an S-valve concrete pump, supplied from Xingtai. The catalogue does not name which published pump uses φ70. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “温度”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 φ70 摆缸密封是邢台供应的一套，用于 S 阀混凝土泵的摆缸。目录没有写哪一台已公布泵使用 φ70。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Staged compression” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Staged compression”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Drive motors”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Lubrication”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
